name: Kelly Criterion Calculator
tagline: Calculate optimal bet size using Kelly formula — maximize long-run growth
description: Enter your win probability and win/loss ratio to get the Kelly percentage — the mathematically optimal fraction of your capital to risk per trade. Includes full Kelly, half Kelly, and quarter Kelly outputs.
metaTitle: Kelly Criterion Calculator – Optimal Position Size for Trading
metaDescription: Free Kelly Criterion calculator. Enter win rate and payoff ratio to find the optimal bet size for long-run capital growth. Works for trading, poker, and sports betting.

faqs.question: What is the Kelly Criterion?
faqs.answer: The Kelly Criterion is a formula that determines the optimal fraction of your capital to bet on a positive expected value opportunity to maximize long-run growth rate.

faqs.question: What is Half Kelly?
faqs.answer: Half Kelly means betting half the Kelly-recommended size. It reduces volatility significantly while capturing ~75% of the growth rate — popular among professional traders.

faqs.question: What if the Kelly result is negative?
faqs.answer: A negative Kelly value means the edge is negative — you have no mathematical advantage and should not take the trade.
